import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebraModules

/-!
# Morphisms of semilinear modules

Restriction to invariants and scalar extension are inverse on module maps.
The comparison is natural and preserves identities and composition, supplying
the affine morphism part of coherent-sheaf descent in Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w w' w''

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R]
  [IsScalarTower K L R] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R]
  [IsSemilinear K L R]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
variable (N : Type w') [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [Module L N]
  [Module R N] [IsScalarTower K L N] [IsScalarTower L R N]
  [IsScalarTower K R N] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R N]

/-- An equivariant module map restricts to a map over the fixed algebra. -/
def invariantModuleMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m) :
    invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N where
  toFun m := ⟨f m, fun g => by rw [← hf, m.2 g]⟩
  map_add' _ _ := Subtype.ext (map_add f _ _)
  map_smul' r m := Subtype.ext (map_smul f (r : R) (m : M))

omit [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [Module K N] [Module L N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
  [IsScalarTower L R N] [IsScalarTower K R N] in
@[simp]
theorem invariantModuleMap_coe (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf m : N) = f m := rfl

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

omit [Module K N] [Module L N] [IsScalarTower K L N] [IsScalarTower L R N]
  [IsScalarTower K R N] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R N] in
/-- Module maps are determined by their values on fixed vectors. -/
theorem linearMap_ext_of_invariantModule (f g : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : ∀ m : invariantModule K L R M, f m = g m) : f = g := by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M).surjective m
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m => simp only [moduleDescentEquiv_tmul, map_smul, h m]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

/-- Scalar extension transports a map of fixed modules to the original
semilinear modules through their canonical comparison isomorphisms. -/
noncomputable def extendInvariantModuleMap
    (f : invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N) : M →ₗ[R] N :=
  (moduleDescentEquiv K L R N).toLinearMap.comp
    ((f.baseChange R).comp (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M).symm.toLinearMap)

@[simp]
theorem extendInvariantModuleMap_descent
    (f : invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N)
    (t : R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M) :
    extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M t) =
      moduleDescentEquiv K L R N (f.baseChange R t) := by
  simp [extendInvariantModuleMap]

@[simp]
theorem extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant
    (f : invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f (m : M) = (f m : N) := by
  have h := extendInvariantModuleMap_descent K L R M N f (1 ⊗ₜ m)
  simpa using h

/-- Extending a map of invariant modules commutes with the Galois action. -/
theorem extendInvariantModuleMap_equivariant
    (f : invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N) (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M) :
    extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f (g • m) =
      g • extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f m := by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M).surjective m
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m =>
      simp only [moduleDescentEquiv_tmul, smul_distrib_smul, m.2 g,
        map_smul, extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant, (f m).2 g]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, smul_add, hx, hy]

/-- Restriction and scalar extension are inverse on module morphisms. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleHomEquiv :
    (invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N) ≃
      {f : M →ₗ[R] N // ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m} where
  toFun f := ⟨extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f,
    extendInvariantModuleMap_equivariant K L R M N f⟩
  invFun f := invariantModuleMap K L R M N f.1 f.2
  left_inv f := by
    ext m
    exact extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant K L R M N f m
  right_inv f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply linearMap_ext_of_invariantModule K L R M N
    intro m
    exact extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant K L R M N _ m

/-- The canonical scalar-extension comparison commutes with equivariant maps. -/
theorem moduleDescentEquiv_naturality (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (t : R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M) :
    moduleDescentEquiv K L R N ((invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf).baseChange R t) =
      f (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M t) := by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m => simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, moduleDescentEquiv_tmul,
      invariantModuleMap_coe, map_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

omit [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
@[simp]
theorem invariantModuleMap_id :
    invariantModuleMap K L R M M (LinearMap.id)
      (fun _ _ => rfl) = LinearMap.id := by
  ext m
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem extendInvariantModuleMap_id :
    extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M M LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id := by
  apply linearMap_ext_of_invariantModule K L R M M
  intro m
  exact extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant K L R M M _ m

variable (P : Type w'') [AddCommGroup P] [Module K P] [Module L P]
  [Module R P] [IsScalarTower K L P] [IsScalarTower L R P]
  [IsScalarTower K R P] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) P]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R P]

omit [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [Module K N] [Module L N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
  [IsScalarTower L R N] [IsScalarTower K R N] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  [Module K P] [Module L P] [IsScalarTower K L P] [IsScalarTower L R P]
  [IsScalarTower K R P] in
theorem invariantModuleMap_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hf : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (s • m) = s • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (n : N), g (s • n) = s • g n) :
    invariantModuleMap K L R M P (g.comp f)
        (fun s m => by change g (f (s • m)) = s • g (f m); rw [hf, hg]) =
      (invariantModuleMap K L R N P g hg).comp
        (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf) := by
  ext m
  rfl

/-- Extension of invariant module morphisms preserves composition. -/
theorem extendInvariantModuleMap_comp
    (f : invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R N)
    (g : invariantModule K L R N →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L R P) :
    extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M P (g.comp f) =
      (extendInvariantModuleMap K L R N P g).comp
        (extendInvariantModuleMap K L R M N f) := by
  apply linearMap_ext_of_invariantModule K L R M P
  intro m
  simp only [extendInvariantModuleMap_invariant, LinearMap.comp_apply]

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
